title: Two pieces, four centres each
notes: Eight vectors of 4 numbers, cut into 2 pieces of 2. k-means finds 4 centres for each piece, and every vector is stored as 2 codes of 2 bits: 4 bits instead of 128. A = (1, 9 | 1, 8) becomes 2 0. The search for (2, 8 | 2, 7) gives A 4.5 by the table (exactly 4), and the same three nearest as exact search, with B and E swapped.
